clue.text: Son's desire to be smart

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for son
a desire is a wish

explanation.surface: A boy longs to look stylish.
explanation.definitionFit: Swish is informal for fashionable and elegant, as smart is.

clue.text: With initial correction, Milton's "Paradise Lost"

parts.note: change Milton's first letter to H and you get Hilton, whose novel Lost Horizon features a hidden paradise

explanation.surface: A tweak to the opening of Milton's epic.
explanation.walkthrough: James Hilton's Lost Horizon describes a utopian lamasery in Tibet; not Milton's poem at all.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the earthly paradise of Hilton's novel, now any idyllic retreat.

clue.text: Source of order confining one to Scottish island

indicators.note: confining means one piece is enclosed by the other

parts.note: Iona is an island in the Inner Hebrides
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Origin of a command imprisoning someone on a Highland isle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' is the architectural kind: the Ionic order came from this ancient Greek region.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ionic order of columns takes its name from this region of ancient Asia Minor.

clue.text: How Us town has put out Westerns in place of Texas

indicators.note: has put out means the following letters are expelled from the words before

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for west, so two Westerns give two Ws

explanation.surface: A town in the US throwing out cowboy films in place of Texas.
explanation.definitionFit: Houston is the largest city in the state, a place in it.

clue.text: When the church has occasion to bless the wicked?

definitions.text: When the church has occasion to bless the wicked?

parts.words: When the church has occasion to bless the wicked
parts.note: the wicked are not sinners but candle wicks: this church feast is when candles are blessed

explanation.surface: The church sets aside a day for blessing sinners.
explanation.definitionFit: The feast of the Purification on 2 February is marked by the blessing of candles.

clue.text: Brute finally heard from this autocrat

definitions.text: Brute finally heard from this autocrat

parts.words: Brute finally heard from this autocrat
parts.note: 'Et tu, Brute?' were the dying words of the Roman dictator in Shakespeare, so Brute was the last word heard from him

explanation.surface: The last word from a tyrant about a savage.
explanation.definitionFit: Julius was a dictator of Rome, and his name became a title for emperors.

clue.text: Awe-inspiring and brilliant name replacing learner, initially

indicators.note: replacing means one letter takes the place of another; 'initially' places it at the start

parts.note: luminous means brilliant, shining
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A dazzling title supplants a beginner at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' says the swap happens at the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Numinous describes the spiritual awe stirred by a sense of the divine.

clue.text: The ultimate in opera — Callas rampaging here

indicators.note: rampaging means the letters run wild into a new order

parts.note: Maria Callas, the soprano

indicators.note: the ultimate in means take the last letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Maria Callas tearing about at the pinnacle of the opera world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rampaging' mixes A (from opera) with CALLAS; the definition 'here' points to the whole clue's scene.
explanation.definitionFit: La Scala in Milan is where the opera singer famously performed, the place meant by this word.

clue.text: Brief army men to regroup

indicators.note: regroup means the letters are rearranged into a new formation

explanation.surface: Soldiers are told to reorganise themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Momentary means lasting only a moment, short-lived.

clue.text: Church body pronounced evil abnormal

indicators.note: pronounced means the words are spoken and heard as another

parts.note: evil is sin, abnormal is odd

explanation.surface: Clergy council declared wickedness unnatural.
explanation.definitionFit: A synod is an assembly of clergy governing a church.

clue.text: Carrying on thus produces ill- feeling

definitions.text: Carrying on thus produces ill- feeling

parts.words: Carrying on thus produces ill- feeling
parts.note: going on and on in this way makes the listener feel sick, the ill feeling being nausea

explanation.surface: Persisting in this manner breeds resentment.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means to the point of sickness, describing tedious repetition.

clue.text: Simpleton without penny, an obstacle, for him

definitions.text: Simpleton without penny, an obstacle, for him

indicators.note: without means the following pieces are taken away from the word before it

parts.note: a let is an obstruction, as in 'without let or hindrance'

explanation.surface: A fool with no money faces a hurdle.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing P and LET from the middle of SIMPLETON leaves the name of the nursery-rhyme fool Simple Simon, so the whole clue defines him.
explanation.definitionFit: Simple Simon of the nursery rhyme is the proverbial simpleton.

clue.text: Allowed state to intervene in this sort of school

indicators.note: to intervene is to come between, so one word sits in the middle of the other

parts.note: allowed means granted
to state is to maintain or assert

explanation.surface: Permission for government involvement in a kind of school.
explanation.definitionFit: British schools of this type were funded directly by central government rather than the local council.

clue.text: Oriental work which ingeniously reveals the answer

indicators.note: reveals means the letters are exposed within the words which ingeniously

explanation.surface: An Eastern text that cleverly gives you the answer.
explanation.walkthrough: The I Ching is a Chinese book of divination, consulted for answers, which keeps the surface apt.
explanation.definitionFit: The Book of Changes is a classic Chinese text, an Oriental literary work.

clue.text: Escape accident? It's touch and go

parts.note: to touch is to hit
to go is to run

explanation.surface: A narrow escape from a crash is a close call.
explanation.definitionFit: A driver who hits someone and flees escapes from the scene of an accident.

clue.text: Impressively appear to reduce bribery

definitions.meaning: to make a striking, stylish appearance
a dash is a bribe or tip in West African usage, so cutting one reduces bribery

explanation.walkthrough: 'Dash' as a bribe comes from West African English.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a dashing show is idiomatic; literally, it means trimming a bribe.

clue.text: Source of Christmas decorations in place of tinsel?

definitions.meaning: holly sprigs come from the holly tree, a wood of holly
Tinseltown is a nickname for the American film capital

explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link word between the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is holly trees; as one it is Tinseltown, home of American cinema.

clue.text: Ordinary people taken round Circle Line? That's sweet

indicators.note: taken round means the first piece is wrapped around the next

parts.note: the masses are ordinary people
O is a circle shape

explanation.surface: Commuters on London's Circle Line find something to enjoy.
explanation.walkthrough: The Circle Line is a London Underground route.
explanation.definitionFit: Molasses is a thick syrup, a sweet substance from sugar refining.

clue.text: Opposed to spurious cut in church singing

parts.note: anti means opposed to

indicators.note: cut means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: phony means fake or spurious

explanation.surface: Objecting to fake trimming in a church choir.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks the Y of PHONY, leaving PHON.
explanation.definitionFit: An antiphon is a short chant sung in alternation, a piece of liturgical singing.

clue.text: Initially posed question in part of film — a backward-looking one

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the word that follows
in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a reel is a section of film

explanation.surface: A question first raised in a section of a movie looking back.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on 'film' in the wordplay: 'one' means a film.
explanation.definitionFit: A prequel tells the story before an earlier work, looking back in time.

clue.text: Part-time medic

parts.note: the doctor in Stevenson's tale is a physician only part of the time, Mr Hyde the rest

explanation.definitionFit: Stevenson's doctor spends some of his time as the monstrous Hyde.

clue.text: Distinctive device in organ score

parts.note: the ear is an organ of hearing
a score is a mark in an exam

explanation.surface: A characteristic feature in a musical composition for the organ.
explanation.definitionFit: An earmark is an identifying mark, originally a notch cut in a sheep's ear.

clue.text: Finishes off ascent with climbing equipment, making peak

indicators.note: finishes off means the last letter is removed

parts.note: an ascent is a climb
ax is the American spelling of axe, an ice axe used in climbing

explanation.surface: A mountaineer completes the ascent with gear, reaching the summit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finishes off' docks the B from CLIMB; AX is the US spelling of axe.
explanation.definitionFit: A climax is the highest point or culmination of something.

clue.text: Motor race — any learner drivers would be daft to go in for it

definitions.text: Motor race — any learner drivers would be daft to go in for it

parts.words: Motor race — any learner drivers would be daft to go in for it
parts.note: a famously demanding road event on Alpine passes, no place for a novice

explanation.surface: Beginners at the wheel would be mad to enter this motoring event.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a long-running rally of the world championship, based in the principality of Monaco.

clue.text: Proceeds from pictures I dispose of

indicators.note: dispose of means the named letter is thrown out

parts.note: pictures are movies

explanation.surface: Income from films I sell off.
explanation.definitionFit: To proceed is to go forward, to make moves.

clue.text: Not the cloth to spread around it

indicators.note: around means the first piece encloses the second

parts.note: to lay is to spread, as in laying a cloth
taken as written

explanation.surface: Not the tablecloth to drape over it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the cloth' means the clergy, so the laity are those not of it.
explanation.definitionFit: The cloth is the clergy; lay people are those outside its ranks.

clue.text: Antiquities man and you collected in Rome

parts.note: vir is Latin for man, hence 'in Rome'
tu is Latin for you

explanation.surface: An Italian man and his companion gather old relics in Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in Rome' says both pieces are Latin words.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtu means objets d'art and curios collectively, the stuff of antique collecting.

clue.text: Congenial company joining jerk at one

indicators.note: joining means the next piece is attached at the end

parts.note: a simp is a fool or jerk
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A firm takes on a foolish employee all at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Simpatico is a borrowing meaning likeable and easy to get on with.

clue.text: Heartless Asian islanders cross with boys only, perhaps

indicators.note: heartless means the central letter of the word is removed

parts.note: the Singalese are the people of Sri Lanka
X is a cross

explanation.surface: Unkind Sri Lankans get angry with a gang of lads.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartless' drops the middle A from SINGALESE, leaving SINGLESE.
explanation.definitionFit: A school for boys only is one kind of institution for one gender.

clue.text: Digitally recorded piece given a look-over

parts.note: K is the king, a chess piece
eyed means looked over

explanation.surface: A recorded fragment gets examined.
explanation.definitionFit: Data entered with the fingers on a keyboard has been typed in.
